observations.fact: Public stack summary reports unchanged navigation and zero signed backsteps.
Of 12 selected slow keypress/input windows, 10 precede the last keypress; 7 have 1–27.9ms processing. Others: 33.6/40.5/47.4ms. This is a bounded selection.
Last keypress/input processing overlaps at 81.3/78.2ms. Shared sampled ancestry includes finish/result, serialization, storage and vendor effects; do not sum these windows.
The 112ms maximum includes a keyup with 1.8ms processing and 74ms through presentation; event duration is not one JS handler.

limits: Profiling changes observation conditions. Its 56ms p98 is not an acceptance rerun or proof that ordinary 104ms misses were repaired.
Samples and overlap establish co-occurrence, not one-function causality. Program/native/presentation samples cannot be assigned wholesale to app code.
Quantized 104ms exceeds the sub-100 target; it does not isolate an exact 4ms culprit. No blind change to canonical math, clocks or 3D quality is justified.
